gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: right knee pain. Generated CC adds clicking during runs, which is not mentioned anywhere in the Gold facts and introduces an additional symptom, so the chief complaint is not strictly the same.

Two-week onset of right knee pain matches Gold; added clicking onset is not supported.

Gold only says 'gym few x week'; specifying 3x/week is an added detail beyond Gold and not supported by it.
There is a prior ice hockey injury with bruising in Gold; adding that patient plays ice hockey, had a fall, and that it was months ago is extra detail.
Onset at ~20 minutes into a run aligns with needing to stop at 20 minutes. The approximate 3-mile distance is an added unsupported detail.
No Gold fact mentions worsening with gym abdominal work or with knee flexion/extension; this is new information.
